about.metaDescription: About Robonino — a UK-based international education & innovation company connecting families and professionals with learning, STEM and global experiences.

hero.title: One Brand, Three Areas of Expertise
hero.desc: Robonino is a UK-based international education and innovation company. We help children build future skills, guide families through study abroad, and design innovation experiences for companies — all under one trusted, professional brand.

story.title: Our Story
story.paragraph1: Robonino was founded to offer families and organizations a reliable, professional alternative in a market of fragmented and inconsistent providers in international education and innovation.
story.paragraph2: Today, Robonino is the official franchisee of Young Engineers, a global education brand active in over 100 countries and recognized by the Harvard Graduate School of Education and the European Commission. We are also proud partners of Education Advisers, a UK-based education consultancy, guiding families through school and university placement.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Robonino ("Robonino," "we," "us," or "our") respects your privacy and is committed to protecting the personal data you share with us. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect your information when you visit our website https://www.robonino.com or use our services, including robotics & coding education, school placement consultancy, and corporate workshops.

sections.heading: 1. Who We Are
blocks:
Robonino
London, UK
Email: info@robonino.com

sections.heading: 2. Information We Collect
blocks: We may collect the following types of information:
Contact details: name, email address, phone number, postal address
Account/enquiry information: details submitted through contact forms, consultation requests, or enrollment forms
Child/student information: name, age, school details, and academic information, where relevant to school placement or education services (collected with parental/guardian consent)
Payment information: processed securely through third-party payment providers; we do not store full card details
Technical data: IP address, browser type, device information, and cookies (see Section 7)
Communication records: emails, messages, or call notes related to our services

sections.heading: 3. How We Use Your Information
blocks: We use your information to:
Provide and manage our educational programs, school placement consultancy, and corporate workshops
Respond to enquiries and provide consultations
Process enrollments, applications, and bookings
Communicate updates, confirmations, and relevant service information
Improve our website and services
Comply with legal obligations
Send marketing communications, where you have opted in (you may unsubscribe at any time)

sections.heading: 4. Legal Basis for Processing
blocks: Depending on your location, we process personal data based on:
Your consent
Performance of a contract (e.g., enrolling in a program or service)
Our legitimate interests (e.g., improving our services)
Compliance with legal obligations

sections.heading: 5. Sharing Your Information
blocks: We do not sell your personal data. We may share information with:
Trusted partner organizations directly involved in delivering the requested service (e.g., partner schools, universities, or education consultancy partners, such as Education Advisers)
Service providers who support our operations (e.g., payment processors, IT hosting, email platforms)
Legal or regulatory authorities, where required by law
All third parties are required to protect your data in accordance with applicable law.

sections.heading: 6. International Data Transfers
blocks: As we operate across multiple countries (including the UK and Turkey), your data may be transferred and processed outside your home country. Where this occurs, we take steps to ensure appropriate safeguards are in place, consistent with applicable data protection law.

sections.heading: 7. Cookies
blocks: Our website uses cookies and similar technologies to improve your browsing experience, analyze site traffic, and personalize content. You can control cookie preferences through your browser settings. [Add a link to a separate Cookie Policy/consent banner if applicable.]

sections.heading: 8. Data Retention
blocks: We retain personal data only as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes described in this policy, or as required by law.

sections.heading: 9. Your Rights
blocks: Depending on your location, you may have the right to:
Access the personal data we hold about you
Request correction of inaccurate data
Request deletion of your data
Object to or restrict certain processing
Withdraw consent at any time
Request data portability
Lodge a complaint with a relevant data protection authority
To exercise these rights, contact us at info@robonino.com.

sections.heading: 10. Children's Privacy
blocks: Some of our services are directed at children (e.g., robotics education, school placement). We only collect children's personal data with the verified consent of a parent or legal guardian, and we limit collection to what is necessary to deliver the service.

sections.heading: 11. Data Security
blocks: We implement reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data against unauthorized access, loss, or misuse. However, no method of transmission over the internet is completely secure.

sections.heading: 12. Changes to This Policy
blocks: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Changes will be posted on this page with an updated "Last updated" date.

sections.heading: 13. Contact Us
blocks:
If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or how we handle your data, please contact us at:

Robonino
info@robonino.com
